issues.title: Inconsistent icon alignment in RTL
issues.description: Icon placement is mismatched across sibling chips, appearing on the left for two items and on the right for the destructive item.
issues.evidence: The link and download icons appear to the left of their labels, while the trash icon is placed to the right of 'מחיקה'.
issues.suggestion: Standardize icon positioning across all chips to consistently lead or trail the text in RTL.
issues.triageNote: DOM-measured on /eval/pair-126 at exact audit conditions (light, RTL, 390x420): Action renders glyph-then-label in one logical flex row, and all three glyphs (Link2/Download/Trash2) sit identically on the leading/right side of their labels with the same 6px gap-1.5 spacing (glyph.left > label.right in every action, e.g. trash glyph 548.1-561.1 vs label 501.4-542.1); tone does not affect order, so the claimed asymmetry does not exist in the rendered geometry — auditor misread the Hebrew screenshot.
